global_locks.style: original 2D cinematic forensic manga-noir; blue-black and steel-grey palette; realistic anatomy; restrained red only as a clue

character_locks.Jian Ci: tall slim pale adult Chinese male forensic doctor; short layered side-part black hair; faint mole beneath left eye; white forensic coat over black high neck and black gloves; never glasses
character_locks.Lin Qian: adult Chinese female investigator; chin-length straight black bob; navy field uniform; black gloves
character_locks.Xu Wei: adult Chinese female forensic analyst; brown high ponytail; olive forensic coverall; black examination gloves
character_locks.Zhou Qiao: young adult Chinese male digital-forensics analyst; tousled short black hair; silver-rim glasses; hearing device; charcoal technical jacket
character_locks.Han Che: mature adult Chinese male commander; short grey-black hair; dark command jacket

voice_locks.subtitle_policy: burn title header and Chinese/English subtitles only after technical and speech QC

clips.title: 同一折痕
shots: closed evidence cabinet and empty molded slot
Xu Wei brings three separated sealed adhesive-paper packets
matching diagonal folds catch cold light
clips.audio: 林浅：剑刺，准备销毁的那份样本，去向断了。

clips.title: 不是随手贴的
shots: Xu Wei rotates three sealed packets with a blunt evidence tool
photography light reveals matching edge pressure
Lin Qian photographs and reseals each packet
clips.audio: 林浅：许未，这不是自己贴的。

clips.title: 固定节拍
shots: four separated sealed packets form a sequence
edge impressions align at a fixed interval
Lin Qian returns the final packet to an empty tray position
clips.audio: 许未：林浅，间隔像排好的班。

clips.title: 夜线
shots: Zhou Qiao works beside a physical city model
three anonymous blue markers connect
the route stops at a night transport junction
clips.audio: 周峤：林浅，三站连成一条夜线。

clips.title: 空诊所
shots: abandoned temporary consultation room with curtains and stools
Lin Qian finds blank vouchers, adhesive-paper rolls and empty sleeves
locked rear door and waiting chairs reveal an assembly line
clips.audio: 林浅：周峤，这里不像诊所。

clips.title: 后来才合格
shots: Xu Wei holds a sealed blank eligibility card
two embossing layers catch oblique light
she seals it in a separate evidence bag
clips.audio: 许未：林浅，合格是后来补的。

clips.title: 签过字的人
shots: Lin Qian separates a blank consent envelope and transit tokens
Jian Ci remains at the clean boundary
Lin Qian closes the evidence sleeve and keeps distance
clips.audio: 林浅：剑刺，签过字也不代表愿意。

clips.title: 还有一趟
shots: Zhou Qiao places unmarked reservation tokens by the route model
only one blue route light remains
Jian Ci stays out of focus at the doorway
clips.audio: 周峤：剑刺，今晚还有一趟车。

clips.title: 界线
shots: Jian Ci stops a full step from the closed cold-storage cabinet
a restrained red reflection crosses his eyes without effects
he withdraws while Lin Qian watches from the clean boundary

clips.title: 换人换地
shots: unmarked grey transfer van crosses rainy warehouse district
Lin Qian observes through a convex mirror
a diagonal blank sealing strip flashes on the rear door
clips.audio: 周峤：林浅，它先换人再换地。

clips.title: 先救人
shots: Han Che divides two action paths on an unmarked physical model
Lin Qian takes an empty sealed evidence case
Jian Ci and Zhou Qiao hold position without weapons
clips.audio: 韩彻：林浅，先救人，再取证。

clips.title: 旧仓库
shots: unmarked transfer van enters an old warehouse in rain
only empty stools, white curtains and an opaque closed inner door are visible
Lin Qian gives a silent stop signal while Jian Ci watches the entrance
clips.audio: 周峤：林浅，车进旧仓库了。
